topic: 流程说明与学术阶段复测
grammarFocus: 被动语态；顺序连接词；定语从句与分词短语的辨认。
title: Academic Writing Task 2: Process Knowledge and Reassessment in University Study
prompt: Some universities require students to explain the steps of a research or study process in writing before they are allowed to move on to the next academic stage, and to repeat this kind of written explanation at intervals afterwards. Supporters argue that describing a process clearly shows genuine understanding, while critics say it mainly tests memory of procedures rather than deeper learning. To what extent do you agree or disagree that requiring students to write explanations of processes, and to be reassessed on them later, is a valuable part of academic study? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类 Task 2 写作练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确你的立场（同意、不同意或部分同意），再围绕“书面说明流程”和“阶段性复测”两方面展开论证：说明你支持或反对的具体理由，并用你熟悉的学习或研究经历作为例子。注意回应题目中的两个要素——写流程说明与后续复测——不要只讨论其中一个。建议用清晰段落组织观点，避免只罗列步骤或描述数据。全文不少于 250 词，写完后检查是否直接回答了题目要求。
